title: Model Directory
description: Override the models base directory. Leave empty to use the default data folder (<data>/ginfer/models).

title: ginfer-serve Binary
description: Path to the ginfer-serve executable. Leave empty to use the bundled runtime (Linux: <data>/ginfer/linux/sm120a/bin/ginfer-serve; Windows: <data>/ginfer/bin/ginfer-serve.exe). The host selects the matching GPU image on Linux.

title: Auto Unload
description: Unload any other loaded GInfer model before loading a new one.
